[[Grave Digger Charm]] |toy_type = Plushie }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Grave Digger Mini Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the [[Grave Digger]] enemy, though it uses its old appearance, which is currently only used by the legacy [[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]] in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. When you bought the plushie, 24 hours after the purchase you would be emailed a code, which allows you to get [[GraveDigger Nametag]] and [[Grave Digger Charm]]. It is made out of plush fabric and Polypropylene cotton, it is 7 inches tall, 6.25 inches wide and 4.3 inches deep, or 17.78 centimetres tall, 15.875 centimetres wide and 10.922 centimetres deep. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Grave Digger Mini Plush'''. ==Official Description== *'''Online''' *:Grave Digger has never been so cute! ==Prices & Stores== Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Grave Digger Mini Plush''' could be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $16.99. You could also buy the Mini Boss Bundle, which came with all five boss plushies, which has a cost of $76.45. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Showcase}} GraveDiggerPlushShowcase1.png GraveDiggerPlushShowcase2.png GraveDiggerPlushShowcase3.png GraveDiggerPlushShowcase4.png GraveDiggerPlushShowcase5.png }} {{ToyNavBox}} [[Category:Plushies]]
